title: Olu nke Sonyere Ugwu
intro: E nyere mkpụrụ obi ezi omume onyinye pụrụ iche site n'eluigwe, wee ghọọ onye ọchịchị na onye agha nke ọdịdị ya yiri ka ọ jikọtara ya na ihe e kere eke n'onwe ya. Akụkọ ha na-agakọ site n'amụma, eze, na ọrụ aka, na-ahapụ ihe nketa nke na-ada ụda site na peeji nke mkpughe Chineke.
clues: A họpụtara m dịka ohu Allah ma nye m alaeze dị ike n'etiti ndị a họpụtara.
Ugwu na nnụnụ ga-ada ụda olu m n'inye Onye Kasị Elu otuto.
Ígwè ahụ dị nro dị ka ụrọ n'aka m, site n'uche Chineke naanị.
Emere m ihe agha nchebe nke na-echebe ndị agha n'oge agha.
Otu mgbe, m gafere ule siri ike mgbe mmadụ abụọ na-arụrịta ụka wakporo ebe m na-efe ofufe na mberede.
A kpọtụrụ m aha n'akụkụ onye ọchịchị nke na-achịkwa ifufe na jinn - n'ihi na onye ọchịchị ahụ bụ ụmụ m.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
